sailings.title: Grand Mediterranean *featuring* Egypt
sailings.body: This extended voyage places Egypt at the centre of a journey linking the ancient worlds of Greece and Türkiye. Depart from Athens and sail to Patmos, where the Monastery of St. John and the Cave of the Apocalypse mark sacred ground. Swim in the mirrored waters of Orak Island Bay and stroll Bodrum’s harbour, where antiquity and modernity coexist. Cross the Mediterranean to Marassi Marina El Alamein, a coastal haven near the site of pivotal Second World War battles, before spending three days in Alexandria. There, the catacombs of Kom el Shaqafa, the Citadel of Qaitbay, and the modern Bibliotheca Alexandrina evoke its Graeco-Roman legacy. On the return north, call at Delik Island and Marmaris, then Milos, before concluding in Athens, a voyage where Egypt anchors the enduring legacy of Mediterranean civilization.

Sail onward to Marassi Marina El Alamein, a seaside retreat edged by soft sands and echoes of WWII history. After a day at sea, anchor at Delik Island, admidst limestone arches and hidden coves. Two overnights in Marmaris bring the colour of Turkish bazaars and the liveliness of the harbourfront. Sail onward to Milos, where volcanic landscapes and pastel-hued villages invite exploration, before concluding in Athens, where classical grandeur provides a fitting finale.

sailings.title: Greek Isles *featuring* Santorini & Hydra
sailings.body: From Athens, embark on a journey through some of the Aegean’s most captivating islands. Sığacık, a tranquil fishing village on the Turkish coast, welcomes you with centuries-old castle walls, a colourful harbour, and unhurried seaside charm. Sail on to Folegandros for a Marina Day, where quiet anchorages and rugged cliffs create a haven of calm. Santorini enchants with its sweeping caldera views, whitewashed villages, and famed sunsets. Naxos follows with its Venetian old town, the iconic marble Portara, and golden beaches, while Hydra’s cobblestone lanes, neoclassical mansions, and a bustling harbour capture the soul of the Greek islands. Returning to Athens, this journey weaves together culture, history, and coastal splendour for an unforgettable Aegean experience.\n

Then sail to Zakynthos, famed for towering cliffs, sapphire waters, and legendary Shipwreck Beach. On a Marina Day, discover Órmos Roúda, a secluded Ionian cove with crystalline waters, before spending two nights in Gaios, where olive groves, Venetian squares, and the nearby beaches of Antipaxos await. sailings.title: The Adriatic *featuring* Croatia
sailings.body: Begin your journey in Dubrovnik, a city of medieval splendour and towering stone walls. Sail to Luštica, Montenegro, where traditional stone villages, family-run olive presses, and hidden coves evoke the rustic draw of the Adriatic. Continue to Vela Luka on Korčula, where prehistoric caves, the world’s longest mosaic, and mineral-rich, therapeutic mud baths reveal a legacy of artistry and wellbeing. Next, Hvar entices with distinctive pebble shores, ancient stone streets, and a spirited harbour atmosphere. Anchor at Milna Bay, an intimate marina embraced by forested slopes and aquamarine waters, before returning to Dubrovnik, where sea and stone meet in a serene finale to your Adriatic journey.

Explore Mali Lošinj, a picturesque island haven surrounded by pine forests and cerulean seas, then spend two nights in Trogir, near Split, amidst its cobbled streets and Romanesque architecture. In Corfu, discover a vibrant mix of Greek, Venetian, and French influences, before sailing to the rugged shores of Golfo di Squillace. Explore Favignana, Sicily’s hidden gem, renowned for tuna fisheries, sea caves, and crystal-clear waters ideal for snorkelling. Drift into Comino Island’s Blue Lagoon, a veritable playground of shimmering azure waters and secret coves. In Malta, linger at St. Julian’s café terraces before sailing to Positano, where pastel houses spill down limestone cliffs toward the sea. In Ostia, the ancient ruins of Ostia Antica and the treasures of Rome lie within easy reach. Then drop anchor for a Marina Day along the Italian Riviera, framed by emerald hills and crystalline waters. In Cannes, browse the designer boutiques of the rue d’Antibes, sip a Kir Royale al fresco, and soak in Provençal savoir faire. Continue to L’Île-Rousse, at the foot of Corsica’s Balagne hills, a sheltered haven of rugged beauty and island charm. Conclude in Monte Carlo, the Riviera’s glittering jewel of elegance and culture.

Spend a day in Baie de Pampelonne, the Riviera’s most iconic shoreline, where beach clubs and turquoise waters set the scene for unhurried, laid-back sophistication. The voyage comes to a close in Palma de Mallorca, where Gothic spires and Moorish courtyards reflect centuries of Mediterranean civilization.

Pause for a Marina Day in Golfo di Squillace for sunbathing, swimming, and watersports, before continuing to Syvota’s, where forested islets and sheltered bays offer quiet respite. sailings.title: The Adriatic *featuring* Croatia & Greece
sailings.body: The Adriatic unfolds in a celebration of culture, colour, and coastal beauty, beginning in Dubrovnik, where terracotta rooftops and centuries-old stone walls meet the shimmering sea. A Marina Day along the Dalmatian Coast invites leisurely time on crystalline waters before continuing to Hvar’s historic lanes and lively waterfront. Discover the quieter rhythms of Vela Luka, framed by sheltered coves and pine-covered hills. After a restorative day at sea, arrive in Cephalonia before continuing to Syvota, a picturesque harbour surrounded by emerald islets. The voyage concludes in Kerkyra, Corfu, amid Venetian architecture, animated squares, and timeless Ionian character.

sailings.title: Greek Isles *featuring* Corfu & Parga
sailings.body: Sail the Ionian and Aegean’s little-known wonders as history, culture, and secluded beauty weave an enticing tapestry. Begin in Corfu, where the UNESCO Old Town blends Venetian, French, and British influences in arcaded squares and pastel façades. Continue to Parga, a jewel of the Epirus coast, crowned by a Venetian fortress and framed by the famed Blue Lagoon. A Marina Day in Molos Gulf reveals golden sand, emerald waters, and a hilltop chapel that feels worlds away. Explore Pýlos, rich in Mycenaean legend, before crossing to Kos, a cosmopolitan crossroads with ancient ruins and a lively waterfront. Spend two nights in Marmaris, where a hilltop castle overlooks dazzling bazaars and animated nightlife. Visit Livadi, a Greek harbour rich in myth, before arriving in Athens, with its ancient landmarks and enduring appeal.

sailings.title: Greek Isles featuring Antiparos & Mykonos

Spend a restorative Marina Day on Rineia, swimming in tranquil coves and crystal waters far from the crowds. Continue to Mykonos for two incredible nights, strolling past the shops, art galleries, and animated cafés of Little Venice, relaxing on remote northern beaches, and savouring organic wines at Vioma Farm. In Turgutreis, explore colourful bazaars filled with artful textiles and exotic spices before returning to Athens, where Plaka’s narrow streets and buzzing tavernas offer a fitting finale to your Aegean voyage.

sailings.title: Grand Mediterranean *featuring* Crete & Ischia
sailings.body: Embark in Athens and sail to Chania, where a Venetian fortress, Ottoman mosques, and waterfront tavernas reveal the many facets of Crete. Continue to Pýlos to swim in translucent waters beneath ancient Mycenaean hills. After a peaceful day at sea, arrive in Ischia for two nights of discovery, soaking in thermal hot springs, exploring vibrant piazzas, and visiting the historic island fortress of Castello Aragonese. Journey on to Porto Ercole, a Tuscan harbour of pastel façades and seaside cafés. Then cross to Corsica for a relaxed Marina Day in the Golfe de Saint-Florent, where unexplored coves and azure waters reward those who arrive by yacht. After taking in the private yachting enclave of  Mandelieu-la-Rague  along France’s Côte d’Azur, conclude your voyage in the elegance and sophistication of Monte Carlo.

sailings.title: Grand Mediterranean *featuring* Ponza & Saint-Raphaël

Continue to Ponza, a secret island of ancient Etruscan and Roman ruins and famed Blue Grottoes. A Marina Day at Golfo Stella, offers exclusive yacht-only seclusion amid translucent waters, perfect for water sports or relaxation. In Saint-Raphaël, a scenic Côte d'Azur resort town, Roman-era ruins, a lovely basilica, and the impressive Esterel Massif mountains await. Savour the authentic charm of Port Vendres, a fishing port nestled in the Mediterranean Pyrenees near the Spanish border, while in Mahón, capital of Menorca, the island’s thriving food scene and Georgian architecture take center stage. Your journey concludes in Palma de Mallorca, a rich tapestry of Moorish, Roman, and Christian influences.

sailings.title: Lesser Antilles *featuring* St Lucia & Nevis
sailings.body: Depart from Philipsburg, Sint Maarten, into the serene waters of the Caribbean before being welcomed by the dense emerald forests, awe-inspiring beaches, and majestic mountains of Marigot Bay. A spectacular sunset awaits in Rodney Bay on the northern tip of St. Lucia, then enjoy watersports on the clear waters of the Grenadines during a dedicated Marina Day. Continue to Le Marin on Martinique’s sheltered southern coast, known for its yacht-filled bay and nearby white-sand beaches, before a full day and evening in Nevis, where Charlestown’s historic stone buildings sit beneath the island’s mist-capped peak. A beach day at Prickly Pear brings sandy white beaches and turquoise waters to the forefront before arriving in St. John’s. Enhancing the journey, Chef Bertrand Noeureuil of two-Michelin-starred L’Orangerie at Four Seasons Hotel George V, Paris, joins as Chef-in-Residence, bringing his celebrated cuisine aboard for a distinctive culinary experience at sea.\n

sailings.title: Lesser Antilles *featuring* Virgin Gorda & St Lucia
sailings.body: Embarking in Sint Maarten, this holiday sailing takes you to Manchioneel Bay’s hidden sea pools and labyrinthine trails. Enjoy sunshine on the transverse marina during a Marina Day off Peter Island before voyaging to Nevis, where a refreshing swim at Pinney’s Beach and a few sips of the famously strong “Killer Bee” cocktail will awaken your island spirit. Saint Lucia enchants with emerald forests and lagoon-like bays in Marigot Bay, while Rodney Bay’s restaurants and beach clubs set the stage for an unforgettable evening. Spend Christmas Eve in Le Marin, full of vivid colours and joie de vivre, before celebrating Christmas on the serene waters of the Caribbean. A Beach Day rounds out this voyage before debarking in St. John’s.

days.title: Manchioneel Bay, Virgin Gorda, British Virgin Islands
days.excerpt: Fringed by forested hills and crystal-clear waters, Manchioneel Bay is a peaceful anchorage known for its secluded coves and easy access to The Baths, Virgin Gorda’s legendary granite grottoes. Here, massive boulders form hidden sea pools and labyrinthine trails, creating one of the Caribbean’s most unique beach experiences. Beloved by divers, the nearby Moskito Island offers stunning opportunities for underwater exploration, making this corner of the British Virgin Islands a dream for nature lovers.

sailings.title: Grand Caribbean featuring Martinique & Guadeloupe
sailings.body: Celebrate the season on an eight-night voyage through the Lesser Antilles, where island culture, secluded anchorages, and time at sea come together in perfect balance. Departing from Antigua, discover the French-Creole charm of Martinique and the laid-back beauty of Îles des Saintes before continuing to the natural beauty of St. Barth’s. A dedicated Marina Day off Barbuda then invites time to swim and unwind, followed by the British Virgin Islands and an exclusive Beach Day in Prickly Pear, revealing a quieter side of the Caribbean before your voyage concludes in Sint Maarten.

sailings.title: Bahamas *featuring* Exuma Sound
sailings.body: The Bahamas’ sugar-white shores and crystalline waters have long welcomed sun-seekers from around the world. But the crown jewels of this beautiful archipelago are the Exumas, with their virgin beaches, swimming pigs, and water so brilliantly blue, it’s visible from outer space. With hundreds of sheltered bays and uninhabited islets to explore, this yachting haven provides endless opportunities for the captain to curate a truly unique journey — from an impromptu stop at a particularly lovely cove to an evening of cocktails on our vessel’s one-of-a-kind marina platform.

sailings.title: Grand Caribbean *featuring* Jost Van Dyke & St Barths
sailings.body: This seven-night voyage departs Miami, opening with a Marina Day in the South Berry Islands. Diamond Cay offers glassy, turquoise shallows perfect for water sports, swimming in the marina terrace netted pool, and simply enjoying the sea. Spend two leisurely days on board before arriving in Jost van Dyke, where palm-lined beaches and waterside cafes set an easy island tone.  In Gustavia, enjoy a full day and late evening savouring St Barths’ fine dining, exclusive boutiques, and French-Caribbean allure. A Beach Day at Prickly Pear offers immersion in nature’s beauty, before arrival in Philipsburg, Sint Maarten.

sailings.title: Sint Maarten to Saint Lucia: Antigua & the French Caribbean
sailings.body: Some islands invite you to linger a little longer. From Philipsburg, sail to Antigua, where an overnight stay in Falmouth leaves time to explore English Harbour’s Georgian dockyards and settle into a waterfront dinner as the yachts’ lights begin to shimmer. At Prickly Pear Cay, the day belongs to pale sands, clear water, and the pleasure of doing very little. French-Caribbean charm awaits in Terre-de-Haut, with its colourful village and sheltered bay, before Saint Lucia’s green hills come into view on the approach to Castries.

sailings.title: Lesser Antilles *featuring* Martinique & Tobago
sailings.body: Setting sail from bustling Castries, this Lesser Antilles itinerary unfolds across seven nights of varied island character. Charlotteville introduces the slow pace of a peaceful fishing village from where rainforest trails and secluded coastal paths meander. A Marina Day off Mustique centres on time aboard, swimming in the marina terrace netted pool, and sampling the yacht’s collection of water toys. In Le Marin, a yachting capital of the Caribbean, polished marinas and French-Caribbean culture shape a cultured experience.  A restorative sea day precedes Gustavia, St Barths, known for its exceptional dining and luxury boutiques. A Beach Day at Prickly Pear leads into St John’s, bringing the journey to a close.

sailings.title: Lesser Antilles featuring Barbados & Dominica
sailings.body: This nine-night voyage  opens in St. John's and quickly settles into Caribbean rhythms with a call at Great Harbour, Jost Van Dyke, a laid-back seaside village set along powder-white sands and clear blue waters. A restorative sea day carries you south to discover Speightstown, gateway to golden beaches and UNESCO-recognized Bridgetown. Canouan follows, prized for its castaway beauty and exceptional snorkelling. A Marina Day in Soufrière Bay invites relaxation on the yacht’s marina terrace, framed by striking views of the volcanic Pitons, while Dominica’s Cabrits National Park reveals lush landscapes and abundant wildlife. In colonial Charlestown, play a round of golf at Four Seasons Resort Nevis before a Beach Day at Prickly Pear and debarkation in colourful Philipsburg complete the voyage.

sailings.body: Begin in Philipsburg, where your five-night voyage eases into the Lesser Antilles. Begin with a dedicated Marina Day in Peter Island for unhurried time on the water with access to the yacht’s private collection of water toys and the marina terrace netted pool.
